source.description:
Follow-up to xtmux-5j3.6. My xtmux-3xs inline callout to /using-specialists SKILL.md was reverted from core (879282e2) because that file is vendor-tracked from the specialists repo per commit 36539725 'fix(skills): vendor canonical specialists orchestration skill'. Editing it in ~/dev/core breaks the vendor-parity gate.

TO SHIP: open a PR against ~/dev/specialists adding the same _[xtmux-3xs]_ callout to .xtrm/skills/default/using-specialists/SKILL.md (or wherever the specialists repo owns it now). Payload verbatim from xtmux .xtrm/skills-patches-5j3-6/apply-secondary.sh US_PAYLOAD (removed in this session, preserved in git history if needed).

Anchor line to insert AFTER: 'live in `/multiplexing` Pattern 7 — do not re-derive them here.'

Payload: '_[xtmux-3xs]_ Under V2 (default 2026-07-13), the coordinator's `message-send --bead` implicitly sets `--expects-reply=true`. A pi parent surfaces coordinator escalations as reply obligations via the `pi-inbox-reply` extension — the parent will wake itself and respond, no operator prod needed. Mechanism in `/multiplexing` § V2 SQLite runtime; delegated-pane side in `/multiplexing-team` § Auto-wake.'

Verified by pi () in message msg-1783918011-3210862 (2026-07-13 06:46). Non-blocking for xtmux-5j3 release.
